Continue from the [parent #5090 handoff guide and evidence packet](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/8994a4b22c465da5d1231f2ce0c937d5441c3c8a/docs/evidence/r1-5090-handoff-20261008/README.md).

Make the existing pushed #5099 candidate discoverable from #5090 at the user's handoff boundary. Current source head is `c9f85aebbf6a80d833913848ccef4d90acc0d1a8`.

Historical scoped component normal/race controls at 4K and 16K passed; whole C/P qualification remains open. The inclusive 16K measurement is 11,972,744 bytes including 601,920 closure bytes, with 13 legacy rows UNKNOWN. External #5037/#5054 work has not been adopted and its final merged ABI is unfrozen. Resolve real merged predecessor identity and ownership before claiming reuse, whole allocation improvement or the 25% avoidable-materialization gate.

This draft preserves source; no new tests, benchmarks or merge were performed. Follow the parent graph handoff for overlap handling, original source bindings and restart order.
